text: Tracker._issue_state now returns None for a missing issue file (no SystemExit); dependency_closed(issue_id, dep_id) treats a missing dep as unresolved, warns once per (issue, dep) pair on stderr naming both tickets and pointing at fsck. list/summary/unblocked/resume/claim no longer abort; fsck's 'dangling dependency' error is unchanged. Two e2e tests added in TestDependenciesAndReady. Full scripts/dev/check green (160 tests).
